simple.summary: כָּרוֹז (kârôwz) means a herald First listed occurrence: Dan 3 4.

definitions.full: H3744. karoz [ כָּרוֺז ] noun masculine herald (loan-word from Greek κήρυξ , κηρύσσειν (K § 64, 4 Krauss ii. 296 f. ; Nö GGA 1884, 1019 doubts ); ᵑ7 id. , Syriac (see Brook), Christian-Palestinian Aramaic [] Schulth Lex. 97 ; compare D § 97 near the end , also K § 64, 4 Bev Dan 5:29 M § 88 ); — emphatic כָּדוֺוָא 3:4 .
